scripts.dev: pnpm db:migrate:local && sigillo run -c dev -- vite dev --port 8047 --strictPort
scripts.db:migrate:local: CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:preview: echo "D1 pre-migration timestamp: $(date +%s)" && CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env preview
scripts.db:migrate:prod: echo "D1 pre-migration timestamp: $(date +%s)" && CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.secrets:preview: sigillo secrets download -c preview --format env | wrangler secret bulk --env preview
scripts.secrets:prod: sigillo secrets download -c prod --format env | wrangler secret bulk --env=""
scripts.deploy: pnpm db:migrate:preview && tsc && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview vite build && wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm db:migrate:prod && tsc && vite build && wrangler deploy
